definitions: To cause a feeling of extreme fear or horror.
examples: The ghost story made my hair stand on end.
The sudden noise in the dark alley made her hair stand on end.
The movie's jump scares really made my hair stand on end.
lemma: make your hair stand on end
synonyms: scare the living daylights out of someone
frighten someone out of their wits
source: make your hair stand on end
